_meta.purpose: Realistic WO templates seeded from public ATA / MMEL / AD / line-maintenance sources for A32x narrow-body MRO operations.
_meta.generationMethod: Per-chapter quotas weighted by real line/base maintenance frequency. Severity calibrated to ~70% Minor / 25% Major / 5% Critical. Deferrable rate calibrated to ~35% (matches MMEL practice; replaces synthetic dataset's 92%). Engine-specific WOs (CFM56-5B / V2500-A5 / LEAP-1A / PW1100G) tagged in chapters 71-80 where applicable.
sources: FAA MMEL Airbus A320 Rev 32 (public draft 2025) — https://www.faa.gov/aircraft/draft_docs/mmel/MMEL_A-320_Rev_32_Draft.pdf
EASA AD 2023-0099 (fuel pump P/N 568-1-27202-005 inspection / replacement)
FAA AD on Kathon FP 1.5 biocide (NEO engine performance)
Aircraft Commerce: A320 family maintenance (issue 111 MTCE A, 1999 ISSUE 07 MTCE B)
SKYbrary technical articles by ATA chapter
Aeronergic / aircraftborescope.eu engine borescope capability lists (CFM56, V2500, LEAP, PW1100G)
Leeham News on EGT margins (CFM56-5B, LEAP-1A)
_meta.schemaNotes: engineSpecific: null when applicable to all engine variants; otherwise one of CFM56-5B (A320ceo CFM), V2500-A5 (A320ceo IAE), LEAP-1A (A320neo CFM), PW1100G (A320neo PW). melCategory: null for non-deferrable items. Part numbers use placeholders (P/N CFM-XXX-XXXX) — never real OEM P/Ns.

templates.title: A-Check task card 200 — flight control surface visual inspection
templates.description: Per AMM 05-20 A-Check package: visual inspection of all primary flight control surfaces for cracks, dents, paint damage, hinge wear, and trailing edge condition. Document findings in tech log.

templates.title: A-Check task card 305 — landing gear walk-around inspection
templates.description: Detailed visual of MLG/NLG: tire wear and pressure, brake wear pin extension, oleo extension, no leaks at retract actuator and door uplock. Sign off task card.

templates.title: Daily Check — log book review and deferred item status check
templates.description: Review aircraft tech log, status messages from CMS, MEL deferred items list and confirm rectification interval not exceeded. Clear non-impacting CMS messages per AMM 31-32.

templates.title: Weekly Check — operational test of cockpit/cabin emergency equipment
templates.description: Function test cockpit emergency lights, exit signs, slide arming positions, fire bottle pressure indications, oxygen mask drops simulated test per AMM 05-50.

templates.title: Towing event — gear pin install/remove and brake pressurization check
templates.description: Install MLG/NLG ground locks for tow, confirm hyd Yellow accumulator pressure for parking brake, walk-around clearance check.

templates.title: Tug coupling damage — inspect NLG towbar fitting
templates.description: Following towing incident report: inspect NLG towbar attach point for cracks, deformation. Dye penetrant if any indication. Per AMM 09-10.

templates.title: Storage preparation — engine and APU preservation 7-day
templates.description: Apply preservation procedure to engines and APU per AMM 10-13 for short-term storage: oil system fogging, intake/exhaust covers, pitot covers, gear pin install.

templates.title: Return to service — post-storage system tests
templates.description: Remove preservation, run engine motoring, full hydraulic and pneumatic checks, refuel and water service. Confirm CMS clean.

templates.title: Replace fuselage exit door placard (faded)
templates.description: Replace ARM/DISARM and OPEN sequence placard adjacent to door 2L per IPC. Check adhesive cure time.

templates.title: Repaint walkway markings on horizontal stab
templates.description: Touch up red walkway markings per livery std. Surface prep, mask, apply two coats of polyurethane paint.

templates.title: Replace cargo compartment loading limit placard
templates.description: Cargo compartment max load placard illegible — replace per AMM 11-30.

templates.title: Top up engine #1 oil reservoir
templates.description: Engine #1 oil quantity below MIN — service oil tank to FULL mark per AMM 12-13. Use only approved engine oil grade.

templates.title: Top up engine #2 oil reservoir
templates.description: Engine #2 oil low. Service per AMM 12-13.

templates.title: Replenish APU oil tank
templates.description: APU oil quantity low — service to FULL per AMM 12-13-49. Honeywell 131-9A.

templates.title: Replenish hydraulic Green reservoir
templates.description: Green reservoir below MIN line. Replenish with Skydrol LD-4 per AMM 12-12.

templates.title: Replenish hydraulic Yellow reservoir
templates.description: Yellow reservoir replenish per AMM 12-12.

templates.title: Replenish hydraulic Blue reservoir
templates.description: Blue reservoir replenish. Smaller capacity than Green/Yellow.

templates.title: Servicing potable water tank
templates.description: Refill potable water tank, sanitization check, drain low-point. Per AMM 12-14-38.

templates.title: Lavatory waste tank service and rinse
templates.description: Drain blue water, rinse, and pre-charge with disinfectant per OM lav servicing.

templates.title: Tire pressure check all gear
templates.description: Check and adjust nitrogen pressure on 4 MLG and 2 NLG tires. Document per AMM 12-15.

templates.title: Engine oil sample for SOAP analysis
templates.description: Take routine oil sample from engine #1 for spectrometric oil analysis program. Bottle, label, ship to lab.

templates.title: Lubrication of NLG steering bearings
templates.description: Apply grease per AMM 12-21 to NLG steering bearings. Routine 600 FH lube.

templates.title: Refuel coordination — fuel quality and grounding check
templates.description: Pre-fueling: confirm fuel grade, check water sediment in sample, bonding wire connected, monitor uplift to flight plan figure.

templates.title: Replace pack flow control valve (FCV) #1
templates.description: Pack 1 FCV reported intermittent regulation, ECAM 'PACK 1 OFF' on previous flight. R/R FCV per AMM 21-26 task 400-001. Operational test after install.

templates.title: Pack 2 inoperative — troubleshoot per ECAM
templates.description: Pack 2 ECAM fault on cruise. Run BITE on ACSC 2, check overheat sensor continuity, swap ACSC channels if no fault on bench. Cat C dispatch with FL250 limit.

templates.title: Replace trim air valve cabin zone FWD
templates.description: Forward zone temperature uncontrollable, trim air valve seized at mid-position. R/R per AMM 21-43.

templates.title: Outflow valve overhaul return — install and test
templates.description: Install overhauled OFV per AMM 21-31. Pressurization functional test on stand or run.

templates.title: Replace recirc fan (one of two) — bearing noise
templates.description: Cabin recirc fan reported abnormal noise by cabin crew. Inspect, R/R fan assembly per AMM 21-52.

templates.title: ACSC 1 BITE check — intermittent pack temp control
templates.description: Run BITE 21-61 on ACSC 1, capture fault history, swap with #2 if symptom follows ACSC.

templates.title: Avionics ventilation — replace blower fan
templates.description: Avionics smoke warning false alarm: investigate blower duct, R/R blower per AMM 21-26.

templates.title: Cabin pressure leak suspected — door seal inspection
templates.description: Slow climb in cabin altitude reported. Inspect door 1L/1R/2L/2R/3L/3R seals for damage; replace damaged sections.

templates.title: Pack temperature sensor replacement
templates.description: Pack outlet temp sensor erratic per CMS. R/R sensor.

templates.title: HEPA filter replacement (recirc system)
templates.description: Scheduled HEPA filter replacement per maintenance program. Two filters in series, dispose old.

templates.title: Pressurization controller channel swap troubleshooting
templates.description: Cabin pressurization controller (CPC) channel 1 fault on ECAM. Swap channel selector, run system test, defer if confirmed CPC1 unit fault.

templates.title: Bleed leak on duct downstream of pack 1 — repair clamp
templates.description: Visible insulation discoloration in pylon area on pack 1 supply duct. Replace V-band clamp and inspect duct.

templates.title: Autopilot 1 disconnect — FCU panel troubleshooting
templates.description: AP1 reported intermittent disconnect on cruise. Run FCU BITE, check pitch trim wheel rotation, reseat FCU connector.

templates.title: Autothrust intermittent — replace ATHR computer (FMGC)
templates.description: ATHR drops out at idle. Swap FMGC 1/2 to confirm side, R/R FMGC if persistent.

templates.title: Autoland CAT III certification check
templates.description: Functional check after recent landing gear work — CAT IIIA dual approach simulation on stand. Sign off CAT III status.

templates.title: FCU display segment fault — replace FCU panel
templates.description: Selected speed display has missing segment. R/R FCU per AMM 22-30.

templates.title: VHF 2 transceiver replacement — squelch fault
templates.description: VHF 2 transmits with carrier noise. R/R transceiver, post-install ATC tower handshake check.

templates.title: CVR functional test — yearly
templates.description: Per AMM 23-71 yearly check: 30s recording sample retrieval, signal-to-noise verification on all channels, time stamp validation.

templates.title: ACARS / ATSU printer paper jam
templates.description: Cockpit printer reported jammed by crew. Open, clear paper, reload roll, function test print weather report.

templates.title: SATCOM antenna LRU swap — degraded signal
templates.description: SATCOM signal strength below threshold per CMS. Swap HGA LRU, perform handshake with ground station.

templates.title: Cabin interphone handset replace at door 4L
templates.description: Crew reported broken handset cradle at 4L. R/R handset, clip and cable.

templates.title: IDG 1 disconnect on overheat — replace IDG
templates.description: IDG 1 disconnected automatically on takeoff roll. Verify oil sample, replace IDG per AMM 24-21. Confirm engine speed dependency at next run.

templates.title: APU generator overhaul return — install
templates.description: Install overhauled APU GEN. Run-up test on APU, voltage and frequency checks.

templates.title: Battery 1 capacity test — yearly
templates.description: Yearly battery 1 capacity check per AMM 24-32. Disconnect, capacity discharge bench test, recharge cycle, reinstall.

templates.title: Battery 2 replacement — failed capacity test
templates.description: Battery 2 below 80% rated capacity. R/R battery per AMM 24-32.

templates.title: TR1 unit replacement — fault
templates.description: TR1 (transformer rectifier 1) reported fault. R/R per AMM 24-31. Confirm DC bus voltage healthy after.

templates.title: RAT manual deploy & retract test
templates.description: Per scheduled maintenance: manual deploy RAT on jacks, hyd pressure test, electrical generation test, retract verify.

templates.title: External power receptacle damage — repair
templates.description: Ground crew reported damaged ext power receptacle pins. Inspect, R/R receptacle if pins bent.

templates.title: Static inverter replacement
templates.description: Static inverter inoperative per CMS. R/R LRU, function test on emergency bus.

templates.title: Galley power outlet tripped — reset and inspect
templates.description: FWD galley G1 outlet tripped repeatedly. Inspect appliance load, replace breaker if necessary.

templates.title: Replace passenger seat cushion (one) — torn upholstery
templates.description: Seat 14C bottom cushion ripped. R/R seat cushion only, no armrest work.

templates.title: Cabin attendant seat shoulder strap retractor jammed
templates.description: L1 attendant seat strap won't retract. R/R retractor mechanism per AMM 25-25.

templates.title: Replace life vest under seat 22A (missing)
templates.description: Pre-flight check found life vest missing under seat 22A. Install spare from stock, log serial.

templates.title: ELT (fixed) battery expiry — replace battery pack
templates.description: ELT battery scheduled replacement before expiry. Document new expiration in tech log.

templates.title: Galley G2 oven door latch broken
templates.description: Aft galley oven door latch broken, door swings during taxi. R/R latch per IPC.

templates.title: IFE seatback monitor blank — row 18
templates.description: Three IFE monitors row 18 blank. Reset IFE distribution box, R/R individual monitor if isolated.

templates.title: Cargo net replacement — FWD compartment
templates.description: FWD cargo bulkhead net frayed and unsafe per cargo handler report. R/R per AMM 25-50.

templates.title: Cabin sidewall panel replacement — visible crack at row 12L
templates.description: Sidewall panel cracked, replacing per cosmetic and safety. Disconnect O2 mask housing if integrated.

templates.title: Replace tray table latch row 8B (broken)
templates.description: Pax reported tray won't stay up. R/R latch per IPC.

templates.title: Engine 1 fire detection loop A — continuity check after fault
templates.description: Loop A reported continuity fault on previous flight. Run BITE, inspect loop routing, replace section if open.

templates.title: Engine 2 fire bottle pressure low — replace squib bottle
templates.description: Pressure indication below limit. R/R fire bottle, install new squib cartridge per AMM 26-22.

templates.title: APU fire detection loop replacement
templates.description: APU fire loop continuity intermittent. R/R loop section per AMM 26-15.

templates.title: Cargo compartment smoke detector replacement
templates.description: FWD cargo smoke detector failed self-test. R/R per AMM 26-16.

templates.title: Lavatory smoke detector battery replacement
templates.description: Lav 1 smoke detector battery low warning. R/R battery per AMM 26-22.

templates.title: Portable extinguisher pressure check — annual
templates.description: Annual pressure check of all portable extinguishers (cockpit, cabin). Re-charge any below limit.

templates.title: ELAC 1 fault — swap channels
templates.description: ELAC 1 reported intermittent fault on ECAM. Swap with ELAC 2 to isolate, R/R if symptom follows unit.

templates.title: SEC 2 inoperative — fault reset and BITE
templates.description: SEC 2 fault. Reset C/B, run BITE, R/R if persistent. Spoiler 4 dispatch implications.

templates.title: FAC 1 yaw damper fault — replace FAC
templates.description: FAC 1 yaw damper authority reduced. R/R FAC LRU, post-install rudder calibration check.

templates.title: Slat WTB (Wing Tip Brake) reset
templates.description: WTB activated on previous flight (slat asymmetry detected). Inspect SFCC, run BITE, reset WTB per AMM 27-80.

templates.title: Flap track lubrication — base check item
templates.description: Lube of flap tracks per AMM 27-50. Apply approved grease to track rollers and carriages.

templates.title: Spoiler 3 actuator leak — replace
templates.description: Servo leak observed on spoiler 3 actuator during walk-around. R/R hyd actuator per AMM 27-64.

templates.title: Aileron servo control unit replacement
templates.description: Aileron 2 reported sluggish on autopilot inputs. R/R servo per AMM 27-11.

templates.title: Rudder pedal feel unit lubrication
templates.description: Lube rudder pedal artificial feel mechanism per AMM 27-21.

templates.title: Pitch trim wheel intermittent rotation indication
templates.description: Pitch trim wheel doesn't always indicate position. Check encoder, R/R if isolated.

templates.title: Sidestick force transducer fault
templates.description: Captain's sidestick reports fault on roll axis transducer. R/R sidestick assy per AMM 27-92.

templates.title: Flap position pickoff calibration
templates.description: After flap track work: position pickoff units calibration per AMM 27-50.

templates.title: Center tank pump 1 replacement — low pressure
templates.description: Center tank pump 1 reported low pressure on FCMC. R/R pump per AMM 28-21.

templates.title: Wing tank fuel pump replacement (LH inner)
templates.description: Wing pump fault, reduced fuel feed. Defuel affected wing area, R/R pump.

templates.title: Fuel pump P/N 568-1-27202-005 — EASA AD inspection
templates.description: Per EASA AD 2023-0099 (fuel pump P/N 568-1-27202-005): inspect motor housing connector screws, torque-stripe verify, replace pump if any indication.

templates.title: Crossfeed valve stuck closed — actuator R/R
templates.description: Crossfeed valve fails to open on command. Inspect actuator, R/R per AMM 28-31.

templates.title: FQI channel calibration — wing tank
templates.description: FQI reading discrepancy with refuel uplift. Run drip stick check, calibrate FQI channel per AMM 28-41.

templates.title: Refuel/defuel coupling seal replacement
templates.description: Refuel coupling seal dripping during refuel. R/R seal per AMM 28-46.

templates.title: Vent surge tank inspection — water ingress check
templates.description: After heavy rain: inspect vent surge tank for water, drain low point, check NACA inlet condition.

templates.title: Fuel temperature sensor replacement
templates.description: Fuel temp reading erratic. R/R sensor per AMM 28-44.

templates.title: Kathon biocide flush — per FAA AD
templates.description: Per FAA AD on Kathon FP 1.5 biocide use: flush fuel system per Airbus SB, document last biocide treatment.

templates.title: FCMC fault — channel reset and BITE
templates.description: FCMC fault on ECAM. Reset C/B, run BITE per AMM 28-42, R/R if persistent.

templates.title: Green system EDP 1 replacement — low pressure on ECAM
templates.description: Green hyd EDP 1 reported low pressure on takeoff. R/R EDP per AMM 29-11. Drain Skydrol per local procedures.

templates.title: Yellow electric pump replacement
templates.description: Yellow electric pump fault. R/R per AMM 29-12. Hyd fluid top-up after.

templates.title: Blue electric pump intermittent — investigate
templates.description: Blue pump cycling unexpectedly. Check pressure switch, R/R if pump confirmed faulty.

templates.title: PTU functional test — no auto activation
templates.description: PTU fails to auto-activate during single engine taxi. Run test per AMM 29-21, R/R PTU if inoperative.

templates.title: Hydraulic accumulator nitrogen pre-charge check
templates.description: Routine N2 pre-charge check on Green/Yellow/Blue accumulators. Top up to spec.

templates.title: Hydraulic line leak — replace section in MLG bay
templates.description: Visible Skydrol drip in MLG wheel well. Trace, R/R hyd line section, fluid replenish.

templates.title: Reservoir level transmitter replacement
templates.description: Yellow reservoir level transmitter reading erratic. R/R per AMM 29-15.

templates.title: Hyd filter replacement (case drain)
templates.description: Scheduled hyd filter R/R per AMM 29-15. Three filter housings to attend.

templates.title: EDP suction line clamp loose — torque check
templates.description: After previous EDP work: confirm suction line clamps torqued per spec.

templates.title: Wing anti-ice valve replacement (LH)
templates.description: LH wing anti-ice valve stuck closed per CMS. R/R per AMM 30-11.

templates.title: Engine 1 anti-ice valve fault
templates.description: Engine 1 anti-ice valve fails to open on test. R/R valve per AMM 30-21.

templates.title: Pitot probe heat element failed — R/R probe
templates.description: Captain pitot probe heat reads inoperative. R/R probe per AMM 30-31. Confirm electrical heat current draw.

templates.title: AOA probe heat fault — R/R probe
templates.description: AOA probe 1 heat fault. R/R probe per AMM 30-31.

templates.title: Windshield wiper motor replacement
templates.description: Captain wiper motor seized. R/R motor and arm assy per AMM 30-42.

templates.title: Drain mast heat — fault on probe heat panel
templates.description: Drain mast heat fault. R/R drain mast heating element.

templates.title: ECAM DU dimmed — R/R display unit
templates.description: Lower ECAM DU dimmed and unresponsive to brightness control. R/R DU per AMM 31-50.

templates.title: Clock 1 — R/R clock unit
templates.description: Captain clock display erratic. R/R clock unit.

templates.title: DFDR download — quarterly readout for trend monitoring
templates.description: Routine quarterly DFDR data download for FOQA program. Verify data integrity, reset.

templates.title: DFDR replacement — exceeded service life
templates.description: DFDR life-expired per maintenance program. R/R per AMM 31-31.

templates.title: CMS post-flight report extraction & action
templates.description: Routine post-flight report from CMS. Action listed messages, defer those acceptable per MEL.

templates.title: Brake assy R/R — pin extension below minimum
templates.description: MLG brake #2 wear pin below limit. Defuel non-required, R/R brake assy per AMM 32-42. Confirm hyd connections torque.

templates.title: Tire R/R — tread depth below limit
templates.description: MLG #1 tire tread below 0.5mm in two grooves. R/R tire per AMM 32-45.

templates.title: Tire pressure low — single tire reservice
templates.description: MLG #3 tire pressure 10 psi below spec. Reservice with N2.

templates.title: BSCU channel fault — R/R BSCU
templates.description: BSCU channel 1 fault. R/R BSCU LRU per AMM 32-44.

templates.title: NWS (nose wheel steering) — towing required dispatch
templates.description: NWS reported inoperative on taxi. Investigate steering selector valve, R/R if confirmed.

templates.title: MLG door retraction actuator leak
templates.description: Hyd leak observed on MLG door actuator. Defuel pressure, R/R actuator per AMM 32-32.

templates.title: Anti-skid one wheel inoperative — defer per MEL
templates.description: Anti-skid valve on MLG #4 inoperative. R/R valve, function test on test stand.

templates.title: Brake temperature sensor R/R
templates.description: Brake temp sensor channel inop. R/R sensor per AMM 32-31.

templates.title: MLG oleo pressure check and reservice
templates.description: Oleo strut extension below spec. Recharge nitrogen and hyd fluid per AMM 32-11.

templates.title: Gear position sensor (proximity) replacement
templates.description: MLG uplock proximity sensor signal intermittent. R/R sensor per AMM 32-71.

templates.title: MLG tire FOD damage — visual inspect and R/R if cuts > limit
templates.description: FOD report from line. Inspect tire surface, measure cut depth, R/R if over allowable.

templates.title: Brake fan R/R (carbon brake cooling)
templates.description: MLG brake fan inoperative. R/R fan motor per AMM 32-43.

templates.title: Landing light bulb R/R (LH)
templates.description: LH landing light reported inoperative on previous flight. R/R bulb per AMM 33-21.

templates.title: Strobe light upper R/R
templates.description: Upper strobe inoperative. R/R per AMM 33-44.

templates.title: Cabin emergency floor path light segment R/R
templates.description: Emergency egress floor path lights — one segment dark. R/R bulb/segment per AMM 33-51.

templates.title: Logo light bulb R/R (vertical stab)
templates.description: Logo light inoperative. R/R bulb on vertical stab per AMM 33-46.

templates.title: Cockpit dome light fault — R/R
templates.description: Cockpit overhead dome light dimmer fault. R/R fixture per AMM 33-11.

templates.title: Navigation light wing tip R/R
templates.description: RH wingtip nav light inoperative. R/R bulb assy.

templates.title: Cabin emergency lighting battery pack capacity test
templates.description: Emergency battery pack annual capacity test. Discharge test, recharge.

templates.title: ADIRU 2 R/R — drift on ground
templates.description: ADIRU 2 reported excessive drift on ground alignment. R/R LRU per AMM 34-11.

templates.title: Weather radar R/T R/R — no return on display
templates.description: WX radar reported no return. R/R R/T per AMM 34-43, calibrate antenna position.

templates.title: TCAS computer reset and BITE
templates.description: TCAS reported intermittent fault. Run BITE, reset, R/R computer if persistent.

templates.title: GPWS / EGPWS terrain database update
templates.description: Scheduled EGPWS terrain DB update. Load via card per AMM 34-46.

templates.title: Transponder 2 fault — R/R
templates.description: ATC TX2 reported intermittent. Swap antennas, R/R LRU if isolated.

templates.title: FMGC nav DB cycle update (28-day cycle)
templates.description: Standard 28-day Nav DB update. Verify cycle, load per procedure, ramp test for routing.

templates.title: VOR receiver 1 R/R — calibration discrepancy
templates.description: VOR 1 ramp check showed bearing error. R/R receiver, recalibrate.

templates.title: DME 2 antenna replacement — corrosion
templates.description: DME 2 antenna shows corrosion. R/R antenna and inspect coax.

templates.title: Radio altimeter calibration after wheel work
templates.description: After MLG work: radio altimeter ramp calibration per AMM 34-44.

templates.title: Crew O2 cylinder replacement — pressure low
templates.description: Crew O2 cylinder pressure below limit. R/R bottle per AMM 35-11. Recheck system pressure.

templates.title: Pax O2 generator (chemical) replacement — expired
templates.description: Two pax O2 generators reached expiry. R/R per AMM 35-21.

templates.title: Portable O2 bottle inspection & re-charge
templates.description: Portable O2 bottle inspection per maintenance program. Re-charge if below limit.

templates.title: Crew O2 mask hose leak check & R/R
templates.description: Crew O2 quick-don mask leak check failed. R/R hose assy.

templates.title: Engine 1 bleed valve fault — R/R
templates.description: Engine 1 bleed valve fails to open per ECAM. R/R valve per AMM 36-11.

templates.title: Crossbleed valve actuator R/R
templates.description: Crossbleed valve fails to actuate. R/R actuator per AMM 36-12.

templates.title: Pneumatic leak detection loop fault — pylon area
templates.description: Pneumatic leak loop fault on RH pylon. Inspect loop continuity, R/R section if open.

templates.title: HP bleed valve replacement — engine 2
templates.description: Engine 2 HP bleed valve fault on idle thrust. R/R valve.

templates.title: Precooler control valve R/R
templates.description: Precooler temp out of band. R/R PCCV per AMM 36-11.

templates.title: Potable water tank leak — replace plumbing section
templates.description: Cabin crew reported water dripping in galley G1. Trace, R/R plumbing per AMM 38-11.

templates.title: Lavatory waste system flush valve fault
templates.description: Lav 2 flush valve weak. R/R valve per AMM 38-30.

templates.title: Vacuum waste system motor R/R
templates.description: Vacuum waste motor noisy and weak suction. R/R motor per AMM 38-32.

templates.title: PA system intermittent — investigate amplifier
templates.description: Cabin PA cuts out intermittently. Check amplifier, replace if confirmed faulty.

templates.title: CIDS director 1 fault — R/R
templates.description: CIDS director 1 fault. R/R LRU per AMM 44-22.

templates.title: Pax info sign bulb R/R (NO SMOKING)
templates.description: NO SMOKING sign segment dark. R/R bulb per AMM 44-31.

templates.title: ATSU/ACARS unit reset and BITE
templates.description: ATSU reported fault. Run BITE, reset, R/R if persistent.

templates.title: EFB connection point inspection — wear
templates.description: Inspect EFB power/data connector for wear, R/R if pins damaged.

templates.title: NGS air separation module R/R — degraded performance
templates.description: NGS ASM efficiency below threshold. R/R ASM per AMM 47-21.

templates.title: NGS controller fault — R/R
templates.description: NGS controller fault per CMS. R/R LRU.

templates.title: APU starter motor R/R — slow start trend
templates.description: APU showing slow start trend per Honeywell 131-9A T/S guide. R/R starter motor per AMM 49-41.

templates.title: APU FCU R/R — repeated auto shutdown after starter
templates.description: Auto shutdown continues after starter R/R per Honeywell T/S. R/R Fuel Control Unit per AMM 49-31.

templates.title: APU bleed valve replacement
templates.description: APU bleed valve fails to open per CMS. R/R valve per AMM 49-22.

templates.description: APU oil filter delta-P switch indicating clog. R/R filter element per AMM 49-91, inspect mag plug for metal.

templates.description: APU ECU reports internal fault per BITE. R/R per AMM 49-61.

templates.title: APU fire bottle pressure check

templates.title: Corrosion control inspection — base check item
templates.description: Per CPCP: visual corrosion inspection of designated areas, treat per AMM 51-25.

templates.title: Pax door 2L emergency slide pressure check
templates.description: Slide bottle pressure check per AMM 52-71. Recharge if below limit.

templates.title: Cargo door uplock proximity sensor R/R
templates.description: FWD cargo uplock sensor intermittent. R/R sensor per AMM 52-71.

templates.title: Avionics bay door latch repair
templates.description: Avionics bay door latch loose. Inspect, R/R latch hardware per AMM 52-43.

templates.title: Pax door 1L hinge lubrication
templates.description: Routine door hinge lubrication. Apply per AMM 52-11.

templates.description: Belly fairing minor abrasion from tail strike near miss. Smooth, prime, paint per AMM 53-50.

templates.description: Pre-flight visual: fan cowl latch worn. R/R latch per AMM 54-52.

templates.title: Pylon attach bolt torque check — base check item
templates.description: Per maintenance program: pylon attach bolt torque verification per AMM 54-51.

templates.title: Cockpit windshield delamination inspection
templates.description: Captain windshield delamination reported. Measure extent, defer per MEL or R/R if exceeding limits.
